topics.label: Feed Loading Failures and Instability
topics.description: Users report frequent failures in loading posts, encountering persistent error messages like 'posts aren’t loading right now', timeline locking, and unexpected auto-refreshes that cause content to disappear. This includes issues with threads becoming unavailable and general glitches preventing normal feed usage.

topics.label: App Performance Degradation and Freezing
topics.description: Significant performance issues are reported where basic interactions such as sharing, commenting, liking, or switching accounts cause the screen to freeze, lock up, or become unresponsive for multiple seconds, leading to a poor user experience.

topics.label: Arbitrary Account Suspensions and Shadow Banning
topics.description: High volume of reports regarding unexplained account suspensions, shadow banning (where posts/replies are hidden or detached), and false positives from automated systems. Users face difficulties appealing these decisions, often being denied instantly by AI or lacking recourse, resulting in limited functionality without explanation.

topics.label: Multimedia Display and Loading Defects
topics.description: Specific complaints regarding video playback issues (such as zoomed-in views requiring manual adjustment), inability to scroll through pictures smoothly, and videos/images failing to load or showing 'content not available' errors, particularly on certain networks.

topics.label: Notification System Bugs
topics.description: A long-standing bug causes tapping on a single notification to dismiss all others or force reload the home page incorrectly, preventing users from viewing missed notifications properly despite numerous updates.

topics.label: Authentication and Login Issues
topics.description: Users experience difficulties logging into their accounts, including being told to download the official app while already using it, and general refusal to accept valid credentials even after updates.

topics.label: Live Streaming Functionality Failures
topics.description: Issues with the Live feature including random disconnections for both viewers and hosts, inability to see comments during streams, and missing battery indicators.

topics.label: Navigation and Interaction Pain Points
topics.description: Usability issues such as accidental navigation triggers when scrolling, difficulty accessing unread messages due to update prompts, inability to write comments, and UI state misalignment where actions (like unfollowing) affect incorrect profiles.
